definitions.gloss: recognition, visual memory, remembrance of having seen
definitions.explanation: The feeling or memory of having seen something or someone before. Almost always used with ある or ない to express whether one recognizes something.

examples.japanese: {見覚|みおぼ}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかって→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧きた。
examples.english: I got a call from a number I didn't recognize.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{見覚|みおぼ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}せない→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
examples.english: I recognize this place, but I can't remember when I came here.

notes:
USAGE:
{見覚|みおぼ}え is almost always paired with ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have) or ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to not have). The pattern {見覚|みおぼ}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧／⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ + noun is also very common as a modifier. Compare with ⟦{聞|き}き{覚|おぼ}え→聞き覚え：13952_kikioboe⟧ (recognition of something heard).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {見覚|みおぼ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to recognize (having seen before)
- {見覚|みおぼ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to not recognize
- {見覚|みおぼ}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧: a face one recognizes
- {見覚|みおぼ}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person one doesn't recognize
